effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Charges through a 12x3m path towards 1 enemy, damaging each enemy hit, dealing 47 damage. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on each target hit, lasting 6s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK).

bio: Ballus was the biggest man in his Legion, and with shoulders like those he didn't have much use for tactics. Or courtesy. Or other people's opinions. His officers often disagreed, though, and it was a great relief to everyone when Ballus the Bull left to become the world's largest mercenary.
